commands.essentialcraft5.hoanna_nest.not.en: There is no loaded nest core at %s, %s, %s.
commands.essentialcraft5.hoanna_nest.not.zh: %s, %s, %s 这里没有已加载的巢穴核心。

commands.essentialcraft5.hoanna_nest.inf.en: Nest %s: %s. Monsters left: %s, players who dealt damage: %s. Dormant for %s more ticks, retry cooldown %s ticks, nobody around for %s ticks.
commands.essentialcraft5.hoanna_nest.inf.zh: 巢穴 %s：%s。这一波还剩 %s 只，出过力的有 %s 人；还要休眠 %s 刻，重试冷却还剩 %s 刻，没人在场已有 %s 刻。

commands.essentialcraft5.hoanna_nest.unk.en: Nest type %s is not loaded, so this nest does nothing. Check data/<namespace>/hoanna_nests/ and the server log.
commands.essentialcraft5.hoanna_nest.unk.zh: 巢穴类型 %s 没读到，这个巢穴什么都不会做。看看 data/<命名空间>/hoanna_nests/ 和服务器日志。

commands.essentialcraft5.hoanna_nest.pha.en: waiting for someone to come close

commands.essentialcraft5.hoanna_nest.arm.en: The nest is ready again and will release its wave when a player comes close.
commands.essentialcraft5.hoanna_nest.arm.zh: 巢穴已经重新就位，有人走近就会放出这一波。

commands.essentialcraft5.hoanna_nest.arm.en: Its wave is still out. Use reset to take the monsters back first.
commands.essentialcraft5.hoanna_nest.arm.zh: 这一波还没打完。要先收回这些怪，用 reset。

commands.essentialcraft5.hoanna_nest.res.en: The nest took its monsters back and cleared its timers.
commands.essentialcraft5.hoanna_nest.res.zh: 巢穴收回了放出的怪，计时也都清了。
